claim: Opening an unread chapter whose saved position is at or above the threshold marks it read with no reading
reason: The shared completion rule: a restored position at or above the threshold counts as complete, as it does for manga and upstream.

claim: Switching a JavaScript snippet off, then on again, has no effect on the open page until the next chapter load
reason: JavaScript cannot be un-run without a reload; a disabled snippet stops reaching anything new, which is the recorded behaviour.

claim: runsAfterReadAloudButtonMigration compares version floats but its name claims the switch is still readable
reason: Order comes from MigrationJobFactory sorting by version, identical to upstream, so comparing versions is the real contract.

claim: A novel chapter marked read below 100% by the new threshold slider reopens at its start, losing the reader's place
reason: Designed and tested: 9ce8a2472 added Resume reading position for exactly this case and device-checked it; the reopen-at-start behaviour predates the range.

claim: Fixture 52 cannot fail: the -Recurse:$false clause it is named for is inert
reason: Line 114 is redundant, but the fixture fails under the refactor the finding names (stripping any :value suffix), so it can fail.

claim: Fixtures 50 and 54 name a recursive delete, but the rule blocks any delete under C:/Users, including a Git Bash single-file rm that it calls a PowerShell delete
reason: Deliberate: the rule blocks any delete inside a system directory (block-dangerous-commands.sh:213-215), and the old rule did too.

claim: Migration tests for 'no-op' and 'left alone' cannot fail if either early-return guard is deleted
reason: Deleting either guard leaves identical stored state, so no test can observe them.

claim: DownloadErrorTitleTest's manga/novel parameterization runs neither downloader, so its 'both downloaders' claim goes untested
reason: A kernel test, the rung the rules prefer; both notifiers call the kernel.

claim: One IReader index entry with a non-numeric version marks the whole store Unreachable
reason: Matches upstream's legacy index handling, where one malformed entry also fails the whole store.

claim: Novel covers now go through MangaCoverFetcher, so an LN plugin's cover string can make the app read local files and content:// URIs
reason: Deliberate write-once parity (9434ed1db): manga covers already load file:// and content:// through the same fetcher, as upstream does, and nothing is returned to the plugin.

claim: fetchPreviewImage body in four EXH sources, three Reikai-written
reason: Provenance wrong: TachiyomiSY has the identical bodies.

claim: Two exh workers hand-roll runCatchingCancellable's shape
reason: Standard try/catch with a cancellation rethrow, not a duplicated rule.

claim: Custom interval matters only under the release-period restriction, written inline thrice
reason: A single set-membership read in upstream's exact spelling.

claim: Quote-on-space tag grammar restated
reason: Inherited TachiyomiSY shape, kept diffable.

claim: Failed-chapter message written twice with different wording
reason: Upstream's file, byte-identical; the wording split is covered by a decision in reader.md.

claim: Novel opt-out from the shared error chrome unrecorded
reason: Untouched in the range and shipped since v0.4.0; the sync did not introduce the difference.

claim: Show removes manual category reordering
reason: Move to top and Move to bottom stay available under a chip; only drag is off.

claim: shownIn restates the type selection rule
reason: One any over the single kernel ContentType.includes; no shared helper exists to call.

claim: Removing the error view mid-press leaves the tap detector off
reason: The view system sends a cancel on removal, so onPressChange(false) runs; Robolectric test.

claim: Dismiss-first confirm dialogs no-op their confirm
reason: No verb reads dialog state back; every site captures its target; tests over the real host pass.

claim: Collate tags restates seriesGenres' tag union
reason: A one-line flatMap; the trim-and-lowercase key predates the range, and collated tags save as Edit info tags that seriesGenres returns as-is.

claim: A Show change keeps the selection, so Dismiss deletes hidden rows
reason: Unreachable: changing Show means leaving Update errors forward to Settings, and no forward route keeps a live selection.

claim: StatsShortcut visibility restated at four call sites
reason: Each site compares a three-value enum against one constant; TAB and MENUS exclude each other by construction, so there is no rule to drift.

claim: Open with and Share accept fewer formats than the import reads
reason: Deliberate scope: registering generic zip, rar, 7z, tar or octet-stream for VIEW and SEND would offer Reikai for every archive on the device.

claim: Dual page kernel copies WebGpuViewer.isDualPageMode with no pin
reason: Gives the same answer as upstream's rule for every positive size, and the KDoc names the upstream function, so a sync touching it shows the link; pinning it would mean an owner-ruled edit to the viewer.

claim: PreferenceRestorer restates the source_<id> settings-file format instead of deriving it from preferenceKey(), and the restatement is looser than the original
reason: The check at PreferenceRestorer.kt:90 is looser than its comment says: a bare "123" survives removePrefix and parses, so it would open a prefs file named "123".

claim: A restore of plugin settings does not rebuild a live engine, so construction-time reads keep the old values
reason: Plugin storage is read live on every call (LnHostBridge.getStorage, LnHostBridge.kt:118), and IReaderPreferenceStore wraps live preferences.

claim: The rule "add a store only while its live key matches" is written twice in the range
reason: The two sites are RestoreInstalls.kt:208-209 (readStore, preview) and RestoreExtensionInstaller.kt:40-44 (addTrusted, commit).

claim: IReader pages build their own data: picture address, skipping the size cap inlinedImageAddress says every stored chapter keeps
reason: The two functions are not duplicates.

claim: The rule 'a filter's current value is the user's, else the schema default' is restated in buildOptions although defaultFilterValues owns it
reason: Both lines exist as described (LnFilterOptions.kt:13 and :35, both from efa83c62e), but what is repeated is one read of the plugin schema's own `value` field.

claim: Crash-log reason words copy Mihon's private Reason.description instead of sharing it
reason: Nothing is copied that could be shared.

claim: IReaderNovelSource.resolveUrl restates the web-address join twice over and drops IReader's protocol-relative branch
reason: The override at IReaderNovelSource.kt:167-171 exists because IReader joins a bare key with a slash ("$site/$path"), which the default NovelSource.webUrl fallback (NovelSource.kt:152, site + path, the lnreader rule) does not do.

claim: The novel-first WebView header rule is written in two RK islands
reason: The two islands (WebViewActivity.kt:83-88, WebViewViewModel.kt:60-65) are each a four-line dispatch: if a novel source id is present, call novelImageRequests.webViewHeaders and return.

claim: Opening the E-Hentai sign-in clears every cookie in the app from inside a composable
reason: The cited lines at EhLoginWebViewScreen.kt:58-62 are a verbatim port.

claim: The native renderer's bundled-font cache still forgets a miss, the defect 7597edbed fixed for user fonts
reason: The code shape is real.

claim: The shared-rail and shared-bar-animation extraction outlived the second reader it was built for
reason: The code is live, not dead.

claim: The chapter-button direction rule is written twice: once in the bar's ChapterStepButton and once in the horizontal navigator
reason: HorizontalChapterNavigator's RTL swap (ChapterNavigator.kt:190-201, 242-253) is Mihon's own unfenced code.

claim: NovelBoundaryFailureView rebuilds the failed-neighbour Retry block instead of calling ReaderError, which manga's transition page uses
reason: The DRY half is the same item the ledger already refuted ("Novel opt-out from the shared error chrome unrecorded").

claim: Both novel viewports re-add the same three spread-or-single paging dispatches, as copy-pasted private functions
reason: The bodies are identical (NovelTextViewport.kt:1733-1738, NovelWebViewport.kt:791-796, and the turn dispatch at :1710-1714 / :691-695), but each is a two-line `if (spreadHost != null) NovelSpreads.x else identity`.

claim: InFlightLoads re-implements Mihon's DeDupeConcurrentRequests, which the same range synced in
reason: The two contracts differ.

claim: Volume-key scroll distance is computed twice with different clamps, and MIN_FRACTION contradicts the shared ReaderRanges bound
reason: The two formulas do differ in code, but no value a user can reach tells them apart.

claim: The 'zones once' test cannot catch a double rebuild, because every rebuild of the default layout is an equal value the StateFlow drops
reason: The overlay reads the same StateFlow the test collects.

claim: TapZonesRowsTest claims to read each reader's own mapping, but its probes are hand copies of the callers, so a wiring bug in either settings page stays green
reason: The cited lines are accurate, but the defect is not what the finding says.

claim: ReaderActionRow hides novel-only buttons on a null callback, but the scope filter means that never happens
reason: Refuted.

claim: chapterPictureName copies the page-save file-name rule, and its Reuse footer says none
reason: Not a copy of one rule.

claim: widePageShape states the wide-page precedence a second time beside PageImageProcessing's own copy
reason: PageImageProcessing.kt is Mihon's own file (refs/mihon has it at the same path).

claim: launchOutliving restates EntryAddFlow.launchStep's outliving-launch shape; both were added in the range
reason: Both are the one-line pattern `scope.launch { x(appScope.async { y() }.await()) }`.

claim: TtsOptions.languageNames restates LocaleHelper.getDisplayName instead of calling it
reason: These are two different rules, not a restatement.

claim: The seam-above-a-held-chapter and end-marker rules are rewritten at six sites across the two novel viewports
reason: The rule lives once, in the NovelSeam kernel (NovelSeam.kt:25-36,54).

claim: Rotate to fit turns each wide page pixel by pixel with a strided read, on the viewer's only decode thread
reason: The loop is real (WidePages.kt:86-97), and it runs on the decode or stream thread that decodeInto uses (WebGpuViewer.kt:316,1502,1732).

claim: evaluate() rebuilds a multi-megabyte chapter script on the main thread, which insert() had moved to Default
reason: evaluate (NovelWebViewport.kt:1035, added by 5bec1e1a4) prepends a guard with one string concatenation.

claim: leftOf and readTo copied word for word into both novel viewports
reason: Both pairs (NovelWebViewport.kt:791-796, NovelTextViewport.kt:1733-1738) are one-line delegates to the shared kernel NovelSpreads.leftOf/readTo (NovelSpreads.kt:15-30), which holds the spread rule once and is pinned by NovelSpreadsTest.

claim: rememberTtsOptions builds a TextToSpeech engine and runs a polling loop inside a composable
reason: rememberTtsOptions (TtsOptions.kt:57-74) is a produceState, a Compose effect API of the same kind as the LaunchedEffect that screen-conventions.md item 7 allows for side effects.

claim: A paged WebView landing whose line seek fails skips the paged share landing
reason: It is true that openingShare is left null whenever topLine is set (NovelWebViewport.kt:468).

claim: where() reads item offsets before the seams are refitted, while measure() refits first, so the first turn after a layout change can pick a page by a stale y
reason: Layout changes that move seams already refit them before a tap can arrive.

claim: The marginTop fallback is dead: optDouble returns NaN, not null, so a missing marginTop reaches placeSpread as NaN
reason: The NaN path cannot be reached.

claim: The bar editor and settings summary count WebView, Browser and Share as shown when the chapter has no web URL, but the bar leaves them out
reason: The editor and its summary are in Settings, outside any chapter (SettingsMangaReaderScreen.kt:221, SettingsNovelReaderScreen.kt:484, ReaderBottomButtonsScreen.kt:127-141).

claim: A paragraph's late onDone can fire the next paragraph's callback, skipping it
reason: A late onDone cannot reach the next paragraph.

claim: Read-aloud's audio attributes (media usage, speech content) are built twice, in the focus request and in the media-button claim track
reason: The two builders exist, at NovelTtsService.kt:86-90 (AudioAttributesCompat for the focus request) and TtsMediaButtonClaim.kt:25-28 (platform AudioAttributes for the silent track).

claim: A tall picture's slice that fails to decode is never retried while the same rows stay on screen
reason: The behaviour is real: onVisible returns early when the wanted range has not changed (TiledPicture.kt:55), and a null decode just clears loading (:66-68).

claim: NovelTextStyle's typeface cache is typed to remember a missing font, but it never does
reason: Same root as two ledger rows on this cache (ledger.md:56, NovelTextStyle.kt:110; ledger.md:258).

claim: The 0..FULL clamp on a stored novel percent is written twice outside the ChapterProgress kernel
reason: The clamp does appear at NovelResume.kt:12 and NovelReaderViewModel.kt:538, but the kernel has nothing to call.

claim: ResumeVeil.pageWaits restates Percent.hasStarted as a float test
reason: pageWaits deliberately mirrors reader.js's own test, initial > 0 (reader.js around line 1968).

claim: ReaderActivity.navigationOverlayState is public, but only ReaderActivity uses it, while upstream keeps it private
reason: The negative claim is false.

claim: The transition page's null download-state branch can no longer run
reason: ReaderTransitionPage.kt is byte-identical to refs/mihon (diff shows no difference).

claim: RK seedColor parameters carry a null default that no caller uses
reason: It is true that every caller passes seedColor explicitly: PagerTransitionHolder.kt:35, WebtoonTransitionHolder.kt:22, PagerPageHolder.kt:77/218, WebtoonPageHolder.kt:239/254 and ReaderActivity.kt:1191.

claim: NavigationSettings.navigator restates the layout-to-navigation map NovelTapLayout.navigation already owns
reason: The `when` at ViewerSettings.kt:32-39 is Mihon's own dispatch for Mihon's own layouts (refs/mihon ViewerSettings.kt navigator).

claim: Classic pager and webtoon transition pages still show a failed neighbour chapter's raw exception text
reason: Ledger row 185 already refuted this claim for range 2bfcfa8ea..c207784c2: upstream's file, byte-identical, with the wording split covered by a reader.md decision.

claim: getPage's stale-wrapper drop copies evictFarthestPage's teardown rather than sharing it
reason: The teardown in evictFarthestPage (WebGpuViewer.kt:566-572) is upstream's own code, the same as refs/mihon lines 457-462.

claim: NovelTtsEngine.availableEngines/availableVoices are never called through the interface
reason: The literal claim holds: the only caller, rememberTtsOptions at app/src/main/java/reikai/presentation/reader/TtsOptions.kt:66, calls availableEngines() and availableVoices() on a concrete SystemTtsEngine, and ReadAloudController (which holds a NovelTtsEngine) never calls either one.

claim: The pipeline keeps a plain-text chapter unescaped for a verbatim text renderer that no longer exists
reason: Nothing is dead.

claim: ReaderPageIndicator tests for a manga-only "not loaded yet" case inline instead of asking the position kernel
reason: The guard at ReaderPageIndicator.kt:47 is not manga-only.

claim: Only the novel side clamps the volume-key distance, and only the novel clamp is tested
reason: The asymmetry is real: NovelVolumeKeys.kt:25 clamps the fraction to 0.1..1, while WebtoonViewer.kt:258 uses `volumeKeysScrollFraction` unclamped.

claim: Two navigation-client tests use hasGesture=false, which blocks everything, so they cannot catch the same-document check they name
reason: The cited line 176 does not exist (the file has 97 lines).

claim: ReadAloudRubyCountTest's KDoc claims a per-chunk lookup the case cannot observe
reason: The KDoc states the rule under test, and the case checks the function that implements it.

claim: Eight WebViewSeamPositionTest cases run only test-local HTML, and two accept either outcome
reason: The count is right: eight cases build test-local HTML, and the asserts at lines 260-263 and 583-586 accept either outcome.

claim: NovelWebBridgeTest handlers drop the token and every argument, so forwarding is unpinned at JVM level
reason: The facts are right.

claim: The bar-preferences test checks only the scope label, not which preferences it carries
reason: The test at ReaderBottomButtonTest.kt:102 checks only `.scope`, but that is enough to pin what `of` decides.

claim: "a user pause while playing gives focus back once paused" passes without onUserPause doing anything
reason: In this case a no-op onUserPause is the correct behaviour.

claim: "reading on holds the end of chapter timer" passes even if publish never reaches the sleep timer
reason: This test checks that something does not happen: publishing Playing must not clear an EndOfChapter timer (it catches a publish that clears the timer, or an onPublished that resets it on any change).

claim: The watched-keys conformance test counts the preferences that were built, not the ones subscribed to
reason: Line 274 does not exist: the file has 70 lines and the test sits at lines 24-29.

claim: The 'paged vertical' dual-page test name promises a vertical case the production code never checks
reason: Refuted.

claim: The reader's missing-chapter warning is silently dropped for any chapter whose name does not open with a bare number, and no Decision records it
reason: The title overstates the rule.

claim: Live word counts overwrite while restore keeps the larger, so a lowered recount is undone by a later restore
reason: The asymmetry is real but on purpose, and manga does the same thing.
